purpose: Test whether exact-lattice action-consequence expansion supplies transferable multi-anchor supervision beyond 197 query-specific FID instances before any V17 model training.
state_definition: query, ordered history, selected mask, reached-anchor count

critical_rules.feasibility: legal actions differ in maximum eventually reachable active-anchor count
critical_rules.primary_090: legal actions differ in whether fidelity 0.90 remains reachable
critical_rules.cost: all actions preserve maximum reach but normalized global future-cost range is at least 0.03
